title: Eurostar urges passengers to postpone journeys due to 'major disruption'
summary: Eurostar urged passengers to postpone their journeys on Tuesday, citing "major disruption" in the Channel Tunnel due to overhead power supply problems.
contentText: The Channel tunnel operator announced a "gradual" train traffic resumption from Tuesday afternoon after Eurostar suspended all trains between London, Paris, Amsterdam and Brussels due to a power supply issue.
